page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.24xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8a.24xlarge offers high memory density per dedicated vCPU, making it suitable for workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage. The hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive applications such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and big data analytics pipelines.
